# ToggleRow

A `Toggle` with its label and explanation, on the sunken surface, as a form row.

## Anatomy

The label and its optional second line on the left, the switch on the right.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` *(required)* | `string` | — | — |
| `sub` | `string` | — | A second line explaining what the switch does. |
| `checked` | `boolean` | — | — |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | — | — |
| `onchange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` | — | — |

## Variants

With and without the second line.

## States

Off, on, disabled.

## Keyboard

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves to and from the switch. |
| `Space` | Changes its state. |

## ARIA

The label names the switch through `aria-labelledby` and the second line describes it through `aria-describedby`, so the whole row is announced as one control.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.
